m.s: Roughly chop {chilli} (keep the seeds if you like it hot) and {garlic}. Blitz with {smokedpaprika}, {oregano}, the juice of {lemon*0.5}, {whitevinegar}, {brownsugar}, a glug of oil and 1 tsp salt until smooth. Keep a few spoonfuls aside for serving.
Coat {chk_thigh} in the rest of the sauce and leave for at least 20 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into chips, toss with a good drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt on a lined tray, and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Finely shred the cabbage and coarsely grate {carrot}. Toss with {mayo}, a squeeze of the remaining lemon and a pinch of salt.
Heat a grill pan or BBQ over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred at the edges and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the chips and slaw, and the extra sauce on the side for the brave.

l: Chicken and slaw in a wrap, or over rice. Skip the chips. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the mayo label.
